Subject: Re: How do I export my data?

Dear [Customer],

Thank you for reaching out to us about exporting your data before cancelling your subscription. I'm happy to help.

To export your data, please go to **Account Settings → Data → Export**. This will initiate the export process, and you'll receive an email with a download link once it's ready. Please note that large exports may take up to 30 minutes, and the exported data will be retained for 48 hours.

If you have any issues with the export process, please let me know, and I'll be happy to assist you further.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
